annotations.title: Signet pledge — withdraw (or see where you can)

description: Without `to`: shows whether your pledge can be withdrawn now, what its account holds and the destinations allowed (only addresses provably yours: your sign-in wallet, your payout wallet, or an address that funded the pledge). With `to`: empties the pledge account there. Refused with `locked` while the pool is locked and your pledge has no outcome. Withdrawing a funded pledge before the lock cancels your entry. Requires Authorization: Bearer <JWT>.

to.description: One of the allowed destinations. Omit to list them.
